```{html}
<style>
  .iq-wrap{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}
  .iq-info{
    margin:.4rem 0 .8rem;padding:.55rem .8rem;text-align:center;
    background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:10px
  }
  .iq-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.75rem;margin-top:.9rem}
```

```{ojs}
import * as Plot from "npm:@observablehq/plot";
import { jStat } from "npm:jstat";

/* ====== Parameter & util ====== */
const muM = 100, sd = 15;                // Laki-laki: μ=100, σ=15
function erfinv(x){                      // inverse error function (untuk qnorm ringan)
  const a=0.147, ln=Math.log(1-x*x), t=2/(Math.PI*a)+ln/2, s=x<0?-1:1;
  return s*Math.sqrt(Math.sqrt(t*t-ln/a)-t);
}
const qnorm = p => Math.SQRT2 * erfinv(2*p - 1);
const fmtp = p => (p < 1e-3 ? "< 0.001" : p.toFixed(3));

/* ====== Kontrol (akan kita tampilkan di bawah plot) ====== */
const ctlDelta = Inputs.range([0,5], {step:0.5, value:0, label:"Δ (μL−μP)"});
const ctlN     = Inputs.radio([100,500,1000,10000], {value:100, label:"n per kelompok", layout:"horizontal"});

const delta = Generators.input(ctlDelta);
const n     = Generators.input(ctlN);

/* ====== Data deterministik (kuantil teoritis, tanpa sampling berat) ====== */
const m = 200;
const probs = Array.from({length:m}, (_,i)=>(i+0.5)/m);
const muF = muM - delta;                                 // Perempuan bergeser Δ
const data = [
  ...probs.map(p => ({group:"Laki-laki",  y: muM + sd*qnorm(p)})),
  ...probs.map(p => ({group:"Perempuan", y: muF + sd*qnorm(p)})),
];

/* ====== t & p (dua-arah, var.equal) ====== */
const se = Math.sqrt(sd*sd/n + sd*sd/n);
const t  = (muM - muF) / se;
const df = 2*n - 2;
const p  = 2*(1 - jStat.studentt.cdf(Math.abs(t), df));

/* ====== Panel hasil (di bawah judul) ====== */
display(html`<div class="iq-info">
  <b>n/kelompok:</b> ${n} &nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp;
  <b>Δ:</b> ${(muM-muF).toFixed(1)} &nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp;
  <b>t(${df}) = ${t.toFixed(3)}</b> &nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp;
  <b>p = ${fmtp(p)}</b>
</div>`);

/* ====== Plot (boxplot + titik) ====== */
display(Plot.plot({
  height: 390,
  marginTop: 10,
  marginBottom: 60,
  x: {label:""},
  y: {label:"Skor IQ"},
  color: {legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.boxY(data, {
      x: "group", y: "y",
      fill: d => d.group==="Laki-laki" ? "#2563EB" : "#DC2626",
      stroke: "currentColor", inset: 8
    }),
    Plot.dot(data, {
      x:"group", y:"y",
      fill: d => d.group==="Laki-laki" ? "#93C5FD" : "#FCA5A5",
      r: 2, opacity: 0.6
    })
  ]
}));

/* ====== Tampilkan kontrol rapi di bawah plot ====== */
display(html`<div class="iq-controls">${ctlDelta}${ctlN}</div>`);
```
